name: ezafe-final-i
title: Listening test: ezafe after a final long i
about: Invented sentences (not from any case). Each sentence is voiced as written without and with the kasra on the final yeh, each in two takes (seeds), with the voice, model and settings of the Persian narration. A control sentence has the indefinite -i, where no ezafe is said. Nothing here is a verdict: a person listens and judges.
